reasoning: $|x {{neg_h|signed}}|\le {{r}}$ means $x$ is within {{r}} of {{h}}: $-{{r}}\le x {{neg_h|signed}}\le {{r}}$.

reasoning: $|x {{neg_h|signed}}|\ge {{r}}$ says the distance from $x$ to {{h}} is at least {{r}}.
